content:
maya: Idea: show a compact permission impact preview in the route editor when changing model/policy. Tiny, non-blocking.

sam: We already discussed previews but not inline. Good for fast feedback.

maya: Right — small chevron labeled "Permissions preview" that expands to show required perms and role archetypes.

ben: Security note: avoid exposing explicit principal names. Show archetypes and permission names only. Mark cases needing audit.

maya: Backend should compute a perm-delta diff so UI can render cheaply. Cache per config hash.

sam: API proto:
POST /internal/perm-preview
body: { route_id, candidate_config }
resp: { perm_delta, archetypes, audit_flag, confidence }

product-bot: feature: add org-level toggle to require perm-preview for route updates.

maya: UX: collapsible, non-modal, link to docs if audit_flag true. Telemetry on open/save.

ben: Log snapshot hash with change record, no raw bindings stored. Rate-limit the endpoint.

sam: Will draft API spec and caching TTL.

maya: Thanks — adding to next sprint.

infra-bot: deploy: console-staging (2024.06.20-0815) :rocket:
